tasks.title: Implement Unit Test Framework for Terraform Resources
tasks.description: Create a comprehensive unit testing framework for Terraform resource definitions, validation, and schema testing without requiring live infrastructure
tasks.details: Implement unit test framework using the existing test infrastructure. Create test templates for resource schema validation, input validation, and configuration parsing. Use Terraform Plugin SDK v2 testing capabilities to mock provider interactions. Include test utilities for: resource state validation, schema compliance checking, configuration parameter validation, and error handling verification. Leverage existing test_framework.go and test_helpers.go components.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for framework components, schema validation tests, mock provider interaction tests, configuration parsing validation tests

tasks.title: Create Resource Schema Validation Tests
tasks.description: Implement automated schema validation tests for all Terraform resource types to ensure proper attribute definitions and constraints
tasks.details: Build comprehensive schema validation using Terraform Plugin SDK v2 schema testing. Create validation functions for: required/optional attributes, data type constraints, computed field definitions, validation rules, and conflicting attribute combinations. Implement automated discovery of all resource schemas and generate validation test cases. Use existing ValidateEnvConfig() and PreCheckController() functions from test_helpers.go.
tasks.testStrategy: Automated schema discovery tests, attribute constraint validation, data type verification tests, computed field validation

tasks.title: Implement Input Validation Test Suite
tasks.description: Create comprehensive input validation tests for all resource configurations to catch invalid parameter combinations and malformed inputs
tasks.details: Develop input validation test framework using existing RetryWithBackoff() and test logging infrastructure. Create test cases for: invalid parameter combinations, boundary value testing, malformed configuration inputs, missing required parameters, and conflicting parameter sets. Implement automated test generation based on resource schema definitions. Integrate with existing test_logger.go for structured test reporting.
tasks.testStrategy: Boundary value testing, negative test cases for invalid inputs, parameter combination validation, automated test case generation

tasks.title: Build Resource State Management Tests
tasks.description: Implement tests for Terraform resource state transitions, updates, and lifecycle management without requiring live cloud resources
tasks.details: Create state management test framework using Terraform Plugin SDK v2 state testing capabilities. Implement tests for: resource creation state, update operations, deletion handling, import functionality, and state migration. Use existing test framework components and mock provider interactions. Include validation for state consistency and proper resource lifecycle handling.
tasks.testStrategy: State transition validation tests, lifecycle management tests, import/export functionality tests, state consistency verification

tasks.title: Enhance Existing Integration Test Coverage
tasks.description: Expand the current integration test suite to achieve comprehensive coverage across all cloud providers and resource types
tasks.details: Build upon existing test-integration-aws/azure/gcp/oci Makefile targets and GitHub Actions matrix testing. Enhance test coverage for: all Aviatrix resource types, cross-cloud provider scenarios, multi-resource dependencies, and edge case configurations. Use existing Docker-based test environment and cloud provider CLI tools. Integrate with current test artifact storage and logging infrastructure.
tasks.testStrategy: Cloud provider matrix testing, resource type coverage analysis, cross-provider integration tests, edge case scenario validation

tasks.title: Implement Automated Test Data Generation
tasks.description: Create automated test data generation system to provide realistic test configurations and reduce manual test case creation
tasks.details: Develop test data generation framework using existing random name generation utilities. Create generators for: realistic cloud resource configurations, valid parameter combinations, test account credentials (mock), and scenario-based test data sets. Implement data templates for common use cases and integrate with existing environment variable management system. Use structured JSON logging for test data tracking.
tasks.testStrategy: Generated data validation tests, template correctness verification, configuration validity checks, data generation performance tests

tasks.title: Build Performance and Load Testing Framework
tasks.description: Implement performance testing capabilities to validate provider performance under various load conditions and concurrent operations
tasks.details: Create performance testing framework using existing Docker environment and CI/CD pipeline. Implement tests for: concurrent resource operations, large-scale deployments, provider response times, and memory usage patterns. Use existing RetryWithBackoff() logic and test logging infrastructure. Include performance baseline establishment and regression detection capabilities.
tasks.testStrategy: Performance benchmark tests, load testing scenarios, memory usage validation, concurrent operation tests, performance regression detection

tasks.title: Implement Test Result Analytics and Reporting
tasks.description: Create comprehensive test analytics and reporting system to track test coverage, performance trends, and failure patterns
tasks.details: Build analytics framework using existing test_logger.go structured logging and test artifact storage. Implement: coverage tracking across resource types, test execution time analysis, failure pattern detection, and trend reporting. Integrate with GitHub Actions artifact preservation and create automated report generation. Include dashboard capabilities for test metrics visualization.
tasks.testStrategy: Analytics accuracy validation, report generation tests, data aggregation verification, dashboard functionality testing

tasks.title: Create Regression Testing Automation
tasks.description: Implement automated regression testing to detect breaking changes and ensure backward compatibility across provider versions
tasks.details: Develop regression testing framework using existing CI/CD pipeline and Docker-based testing. Create tests for: API compatibility across versions, configuration backward compatibility, state file compatibility, and provider upgrade scenarios. Use existing multi-stage Docker builds and matrix testing capabilities. Implement automated comparison of test results across versions.
tasks.testStrategy: Version compatibility tests, API regression detection, configuration compatibility validation, upgrade scenario testing

tasks.title: Integrate Security and Compliance Testing
tasks.description: Implement security testing capabilities to validate credential handling, secure communication, and compliance with security best practices
tasks.details: Build security testing framework using existing Gosec integration and environment variable management. Implement tests for: credential security validation, secure API communication, secret handling verification, and compliance checking. Use existing cloud provider CLI tools for security validation. Include automated security scan integration and vulnerability detection capabilities.
tasks.testStrategy: Security scan validation, credential handling tests, communication security verification, compliance requirement testing
